CustomField.description: Custom wording for a picklist's options on this form, without changing the picklist itself. Edited in Form Builder's Customize Option Labels window and stored as JSON mapping each API value to its label. Saved values stay the API names, and merge fields that show the answer use the custom wording too. Labels can include merge fields and custom labels; options without an entry keep their standard translated label.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maps picklist values to custom display labels, managed from the Customize Option Labels editor in Form Builder. Only what respondents see changes: saved values keep their API names, and any value without an override keeps its default label.
CustomField.label: Picklist Option Labels
